label.purpose: Buttons, chips, toolbar, overlines; condensed uppercase.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Brand action button; uppercase condensed label on forest green.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #346751; color: #ffffff; font-family: 'Roboto Condensed', Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.16667em; text-transform: uppercase; border: none; border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px 16px; min-height: 2.572em; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #224e3b; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #9dd9d2; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Toolbar Button
components.description: Flat round icon button floating over the map.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-toolbar" aria-label="Layers"><svg width="22" height="22" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><polygon points="12 2 2 7 12 12 22 7 12 2"/><polyline points="2 17 12 22 22 17"/><polyline points="2 12 12 17 22 12"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-btn-toolbar { background: transparent; color: #ffffff; border: none; border-radius: 50%; width: 40px; height: 40px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-toolbar:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); } .ds-btn-toolbar:active { opacity: 0.7; } .ds-btn-toolbar:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #9dd9d2; }

components.name: Hut Type Chip
components.description: Compact meta chip for hut classification.
components.css: .ds-chip-type { background: #112119; color: #9dd9d2; font-family: 'Roboto Condensed', Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; border-radius: 6px; padding: 2px 10px; display: inline-block; }

components.name: Availability Chip
components.description: Bed availability signal; green = bookable, red = closed/full.
components.css: .ds-chip-avail { font-family: 'Roboto Condensed', Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; border-radius: 6px; padding: 2px 10px; display: inline-block; } .ds-chip-avail--ok { background: rgba(37,193,94,0.15); color: #25c15e; } .ds-chip-avail--no { background: rgba(191,33,30,0.15); color: #bf211e; }

components.name: Map Surface Card
components.description: Floating panel over the map; tonal, no shadow.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #112119; color: #ffffff; border-radius: 6px; padding: 16px; } .ds-card__title { display: block; font-family: 'Roboto Condensed', Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.0125em; } .ds-card__meta { display: block; margin-top: 4px; color: #9dd9d2; font-size: 0.875rem; }

components.name: Halo Label
components.description: Signature: map-over imagery label with brand halo.
components.css: .ds-halo { color: #ffffff; font-family: 'Roboto Condensed', Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; letter-spacing: 0.02em; text-shadow: 0 0 4px rgba(26,66,49,0.7); }

narrative.overview: Wodore's UI is a night-vision instrument panel for the mountains: a dark pine surface on which the map is the primary instrument and every control is a low-glare, high-legibility instrument reading. The palette comes straight from the alpine night: deep pine and pine-panel surfaces, a restrained forest green as the brand voice, glacier turquoise for orientation and information, and a rare gold accent that behaves like a head-torch beam: small, warm, pointed. Density is compact and operational. Roboto Condensed, uppercase labels and 6px corners give controls a field-instrument feel rather than a consumer-app feel. Depth comes from tonal layering of the pine surfaces and the map itself, not from shadows.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-first: page background Night Pine (#0a140f), panels Pine Panel (#112119)
Map is the canvas; chrome floats over it in compact panels
Green is identity, turquoise is orientation, gold is scarce emphasis
Condensed uppercase labels; generous Roboto body
Flat tonal surfaces, 6px corners, 20px only for dialogs
Halo text-shadow keeps labels legible over map imagery

rules.name: The Head-Torch Rule
rules.body: Gold is a beam, not a wash: link underlines and small highlights only. If gold covers more than a few percent of a surface, the design has lost the night.

rules.name: The Availability Rule
rules.body: Signal green and alpine red belong to bed/availability truth. Never spend them on decoration; a green button that doesn't mean "available" dilutes the product's core signal.

rules.name: The Instrument Label Rule
rules.body: Interactive controls speak in condensed uppercase labels (+0.167em tracking). Sentence case is for content, not controls.

rules.name: The Tonal Layer Rule
rules.body: To raise a surface, step the pine tone; do not add drop shadows.

dos: Do keep the map as the dominant surface; chrome floats in compact panels at the edges.
Do use the halo effect for any text that sits directly on map imagery.
Do step pine tones (Night Pine → Panel → Deep) to express hierarchy.
Do keep controls uppercase condensed; content sentence case.
Do respect the 100–900 ramps; pick existing shades over inventing new values.
donts: Don't introduce drop shadows for elevation; the system is tonal.
Don't spend gold or the availability green/red on decoration.
Don't place large light surfaces over the map without a tonal bridge.
